note: SH1054 — the accessibility violations below serious that a console route is known to have, by route family and axe rule id. console-check.mjs runs axe on every route: a serious or critical violation always fails, a lesser one fails unless its family lists it here, and an entry no run observes any more is reported so it can be deleted. The map shrinks only by deletion.

vendor..graphiql-container: GraphiQL's own editor and tab strip, embedded and not authored here: its Monaco theme draws line numbers and comments below 4.5:1 and its tabs hold their close buttons (nested-interactive). Excluded from axe by name, printed on every run, and deleted the day the explorer stops being a vendored component.
